title: Should a bottom-bar inventory button open a pictured item picker?
question: You suggested a button beside the currently selected item at the bottom of the screen. Pressing it would open an inventory pop-up with larger pictures and a count for each item; tapping an item would select it directly. The existing selected-item button would still cycle items. Should this be the inventory direction? This revises the earlier question about replacing crop-count text with tiny basket marks; that earlier picture is not the proposed pop-up. The 2026-09-01 decision about showing the object and a check mark when a tap changes nothing remains settled.
why_now: The current on-screen display shows abbreviated crop counts and a selected-item button that cycles through items. Daniel proposed a separate, larger inventory view for seeing quantities and selecting an item directly. The attached live capture documents the older text-versus-tiny-marks comparison only; it is a baseline, not a preview of the proposed pop-up window. No pop-up has been implemented or shown in a live capture yet.

options.label: Open an inventory pop-up from the bottom bar
options.detail: Add a button beside the selected-item button. It opens a pop-up with larger item pictures and exact counts; choosing an item closes the pop-up and makes that item active. Keep tapping the selected-item button to cycle, so both selection paths work. Replace the tiny basket-marks proposal with this direction; determine the final way to display counts on the game screen during implementation.

options.label: Keep the current on-screen display and cycling
options.detail: Keep the crop-count text and selected-item cycling as shipped. Do not add an inventory pop-up or replace the text with the old tiny basket marks.

options.label: Show the pop-up in a live comparison first
options.detail: Keep the current on-screen display while Elena prepares a live comparison using buttons sized for touch, showing the proposed bottom button, open pop-up, larger item pictures, counts, and direct selection. Return with that evidence before choosing whether to build it.

attachments.caption: Historical baseline only: same live farm with shipped crop-count text at left and the earlier tiny basket marks at right. This does not depict Daniel's proposed inventory pop-up, larger item pictures, or direct selection.

subject: Pictured inventory access and direct item selection

replies.text: I revised Q-119 around your bottom-bar inventory button: it would sit beside the current selected-item button, open a pop-up with larger item pictures and exact counts, and let you choose an item directly while the current button still cycles. The choices now let you choose that direction, keep the shipped on-screen display, or see a live comparison using buttons sized for touch first. The attached old text-versus-tiny-basket capture is labeled as historical; it does not show the pop-up. Your earlier noun-and-check-mark tap ruling remains separate. No gameplay controls were changed for this revision.

ruled.summary: Ruled 2026-09-24: (a). A bottom-bar button opens a pictured inventory for direct selection (S-23, design/11). Not built yet.
